items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Another star in there was Booker Pitman... Ben Webster, Joe Keyes, Jack Washington... whenever they played a dance... some of my men was always there

ctx.x: Yeah. So I went over to catch him and he said he was going to be at his opening. So when I looked up, Joe Keyes wasn't there. And I said to Count, where's Joe? He just had too much, I just couldn't bring him on the bandstand and mess us up drunk, I wouldn't do that. I told him, I said Count, how come you don't get (inaudible). Count said don't you know, that's one of the best first trumpet men in the business? I said he sure is, but you're playing tonight without him. He said you need somebody that you know what…

read it and he said, you don't have to look over it now. He said read it by yourself, with the men and everything and if you want to sign it, keep one copy and send me the other. He said I'd like to bring you into New York, I think I can do something for you. Hammond's a recorder, he's over Columbia and if he doesn't record you with Columbia, he will record you on a subsidiary.
